results.description: Innovation S5: evidence-request policies on SYNTHETIC JSON-only cases with a hidden latent truth. Replaces the circular 'next-best-evidence top-1 vs resolving document' headline.

design.extraction: oracle: truth.oracle_extraction through the real checks and contradiction builder, with the oracle page text scanned for embedded instructions (no OCR, no PDF)

held_out_family.chosen: 2026-10-14, before any simulation was run (the Phase 4 spec's example)
held_out_family.rule: cases containing it were never simulated during development (development-split cases with it are never simulated); test-split cases with it are reported only under held_out_family
held_out_family.disclosure: the engine's detection of this problem (open_items_insurance.claims_history_items) was written and unit-tested by the engine build on other generated packets (seed 4040) before the simulator existed; the hold-out covers simulator development and every simulation result

policies.voi: highest nonzero VOI first; stop when no open request has a VOI above zero (innovation S5 rule)
policies.voi_lookahead: voi, then the zero-VOI request with the highest nonzero lookahead value (an addition)
policies.checklist: every open request in the fixed severity order of evidence.open_items.PROBLEM_ORDER (the catalog has no severity field)
policies.random: every open request in a seeded shuffled order
policies.oracle: knows the truth: cheapest cost-weighted request sequence that reaches the full-information recommendation (exhaustive uniform-cost search over request orders; only cases with at most 4 open requests at the start)

design.headline_policy: voi (the specified S5 stopping rule); voi_lookahead is reported as an addition

priors_variants.latent_x0.5: prior of the latent (true) option x0.5, renormalized
priors_variants.latent_x1.5: prior of the latent (true) option x1.5, renormalized
priors_variants.latent_removed: latent (true) option removed from the option set, renormalized

metrics.requests_per_case: number of requests the policy made
metrics.cost_weighted_requests_per_case: sum of the catalog cost weights of those requests
metrics.zero_value_requests_per_case: requests whose VOI was 0 just before (under the variant's priors) and whose reveal did not change the recommendation
metrics.decision_error_rate: share of cases whose final recommendation differs from the full-information recommendation (every planted problem revealed)
metrics.requests_to_stable_when_reached: requests after which the recommendation equals the full-information recommendation and stays; cases ending on another recommendation are left out

reading_notes: The voi policy only makes requests whose VOI is above zero, so its zero-value request count is 0 by construction; the comparison is how many zero-value requests the other policies make.

Scaling the latent option's prior by 0.5 or 1.5 keeps every prior above zero, so it cannot change WHICH requests have a VOI above zero, only their values and order; for the voi policy, differences between the documented, x0.5 and x1.5 rows come only from the order of several nonzero requests. Removing the latent option can change which requests have value. voi_lookahead also depends on which option is most likely.
Checklist, random and oracle make the same requests under every priors variant; only the VOI they are valued at, and so the zero-value count, can change.

The full-information recommendation reveals every planted problem. A planted problem that no open item stands for cannot be requested by any policy; decision_error_rate_when_every_planted_problem_detected leaves those cases out.

requests_to_stable_when_reached averages only the cases where the run ends on the full-information recommendation, so its case set differs between policies; the paired comparison uses the cases both reached.

The oracle stops at the first state whose recommendation equals the full-information recommendation. That state need not be the full-information state: when a planted problem is undetected, another open problem can give the same recommendation, so 'oracle reached' does not mean every problem was revealed.

The full-information recommendation is what the SYNTHETIC reference policy (agent/policy.py) gives once every planted problem is revealed; it is the benchmark here, not a claim about the right lending or underwriting decision.

headline.group: test split without the held-out family, all lines, documented priors
headline.comparison: voi minus checklist, per case, paired bootstrap (1,000 resamples, seed 42)

not_claimable: real time or cost savings (cost weights and priors are planning assumptions)
that the VOI score is optimal or an economic model
extraction accuracy (the simulator uses the generator's oracle extraction)
anything about real applications: every case is SYNTHETIC
